─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
RED BASELINE
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Initial draft hit a constructor-signature mismatch + a karen finding:
- ResizeImageCommand / RotateImageCommand / CropImageCommand take an
  ImageContentEditor* + xobjectName + transform-specific args (origin,
  size, angle, center) -- not the (manager, doc, page, idx, rect)
  signature my draft assumed.
- RemoveImageCommand parameter ORDER is (manager, page, doc, idx) --
  my draft passed (manager, doc, page, idx).
- I initially consolidated Resize/Rotate/Crop into a single
  EnumerateImagesReturnsCtmBoundingBox test on the (false) claim that
  test_image_commands.cpp already covered transform commands. Karen
  caught this: test_image_commands.cpp covers Insert and Remove only,
  zero Resize/Rotate/Crop tests anywhere in the suite.

Remediation (no production change):
1. Resize/Rotate/Crop dedicated tests added with full save/reopen
   round-trip via ImageContentEditor.
2. RemoveImageCommand argument order corrected.
